decisions.reason: Identical observation sources do not mean equal information if ledger summarizes a longer prefix than B3.
decisions.choice: Both derive from the identical available finite prefix; bind start/end/length and digest. A longer persistent ledger becomes an explicit memory ablation, not C1.
decisions.source: Independent design review during this increment.

decisions.reason: Old contract permits only8 validation attempts but calls for selecting checkpoints across21 learned-run equivalents; at least21 policy validations would exceed the cap even before multiple checkpoints.
decisions.choice: New organized study uses final fixed10000-adaptation-update checkpoint for every arm and seed. The8 validation attempts assess collector/task qualification only; no per-arm performance selection.
decisions.override_of: method_contract_root_v02 budgets.checkpoint only, which was not executed
decisions.cap_failure: If training cannot reach the fixed update count at2GPUh, record INCOMPLETE_COMMON_UPDATE_COMPARISON; do not select earlier checkpoint or extend selective budget.

decisions.reason: Six of12 evaluation cells are irrecoverable negatives; pooled complete success at most0.5, so pooled0.15 go gain means0.30 in recoverable half. Seeds and frames do not create new task graphs.
decisions.choice: Preserve all-attempt pooled primary plus recoverable/irrecoverable strata. Separate unavoidable contract failure from avoidable unsafe actuation. Two graphs/12 world cells remain pilot; no population generalization from iid tests on36 repeatedseed outcomes.
decisions.confirmatory: New independently frozen task-source pool and power assumptions after pilot; do not tune using H01/H02 and reuse as untouched.

decisions.reason: An unconditional originalD check would remove real latefailure F and localrecovery R, and a safe-state requirement on read-only studentvisits would exclude genuine unsafe failures.
decisions.choice: Keep original deadline/fullFALSE absorbing; record actual unsafe observations; distinguish ORIGINAL_GOAL, SAFE_LOCAL_RECOVERY and SAFETY_ABORT with independent per-action authorization. UNKNOWN afterD may allow safety-only stop without becomingFALSE or qualifiedR.
decisions.evidence: Root G1v01 source semanticfinding; separate v02 correction plus independent review.
